verdict.rationale: Chargebee ships background-running automations (webhooks triggered by events, smart dunning retries, async export jobs) that operate autonomously once configured, and it also exposes MCP servers so AI clients can call these APIs. However there's no evidence of an AI agent itself configuring or orchestrating persistent background automation workflows — MCP usage described is interactive/live calls, not autonomous scheduled agent tasks. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-agent-authored recurring/scheduled automations, agentic workflow builders, or independent confirmation that MCP-driven actions run unattended in the background.
